_help.MIN_STORE_USD: Trades smaller than this (USD) are not stored.
_help.MAX_MEME_MCAP: Tokens above this market cap are not treated as memes.
_help.MINE_MANUAL_MAX: Max tokens per manual mining request.
_help.MINE_MIN_ATH: Auto-mining only looks at tokens whose ATH market cap reached this (USD).
_help.MINE_TRAP_SELLERS: If fewer than this share of top-profit wallets ever sold, treat the token as unsellable.
_help.MINE_TRAP_TAX: Sell tax at or above this share marks the token as a honeypot.
_help.SIGNAL_LOG_WINDOW: Time window (seconds) used when logging signals for review.
_help.SIGNAL_LOG_MIN_USD: Minimum single buy (USD) that counts toward a logged signal.
_help.SIGNAL_BOT_TRADES: 30-day trade count at or above which a wallet is treated as a bot.
_help.FLIP_SECONDS: A buy sold within this many seconds counts as a flip.
_help.FLIP_MIN_TOKENS: Minimum tokens bought and sold before flip detection applies.
_help.FLIP_SHARE: Share of flips at or above which a wallet is treated as a bot.
_help.PICK_MCAP: Market-cap range (USD) for the 'picks' paper-tracking group.
_help.PICK_SINCE: Unix time from which picks count as out-of-sample.
_help.REVIEW_HOURS: Local hours at which the automatic review runs.
_help.WALLET_MIN_SIGNALS: Minimum settled signals before a wallet is ranked.
_help.SIM_COST: Round-trip cost per simulated trade (fees + slippage).
_help.WALLET_SHRINK: Shrinkage toward the overall mean, in pseudo-signals per wallet.
_help.RELATED_MIN_SHARED: Signals two wallets must share to be grouped as related.
_help.RELATED_OVERLAP: Overlap share needed to group two wallets as related.
_help.RELATED_FUNDER_MAX: A funder that paid more wallets than this is treated as a distributor.
_help.PROFIT_USD: Per-token total PnL (USD) for the 'profitable' label.
_help.LONG_PNL_USD: 30-day realized PnL (USD) for the 'long-term profit' label.
_help.QUIET_PNL_USD: Wallets whose overall profit stays below this (USD) are hidden and later archived.
_help.EARLY_SECONDS: Holding started within this many seconds of token creation counts as early.
_help.GOLD_X: ATH divided by the wallet's average buy price needed for a 'gold' hit.
_help.GOLD_MC_USD: Minimum ATH market cap (USD) for a 'gold' hit.
_help.FRESH_DAYS: Wallets first funded within this many days count as fresh.
_help.PAPER_SOLD: Sold share for the 'paper hands' label.
_help.PAPER_X: ATH divided by the average sell price for the 'sold too early' label.
_help.TOP_SELL_RATIO: Average sell market cap divided by ATH market cap for 'sold near the top'.
_help.GOLD_REGULAR_MIN: Distinct early gold hits needed for 'gold regular'.
_help.BOT_TRADES_30D: 30-day trade count at or above which a wallet is treated as a bot.
_help.BOT_TOKENS_30D: 30-day distinct tokens at or above which a wallet is treated as a bot.
_help.QUIET_SINCE: Unix time from which the overall-profit rule applies to older wallets.
_help.PRUNE_AFTER_DAYS: Days in the library before a quiet wallet is archived.
_help.FOLLOW_MIN_N: Follow records needed before the number is shown.
_help.HIGH_FREQ_TRADES: 30-day trades for the 'high frequency' export tag.
_help.EARLY_PROFIT_SECONDS: Entry within this many seconds of launch for the 'early high profit' label.
_help.EARLY_PROFIT_USD: Per-token total PnL (USD) for the 'early high profit' label.
_help.EARLY_PROFIT_ROI: Per-token ROI (%) that also qualifies for the 'early high profit' label.
_help.SCORE_WEIGHTS: Wallet score (0-100): weight of each part. Should add up to 1.
_help.SCORE_SCALE: Wallet score: where each part scores 0 and full marks (30-day realized USD on a log scale, ROI, share of 2x+ tokens, win rate, tokens traded).
_help.SCORE_PENALTY: Wallet score multipliers: token creators (created at least devMinTokens and more than devShare of traded tokens), bots, tiny average buys (below dustUsd) and thin samples (fewer than thinTokens).
_help.GRADE_FLOORS: Minimum score for each grade; anything lower is D.
_help.GRADE_WEIGHT: Signal weight of a wallet by grade.
_help.SIGNAL: Consensus signals: weights for unscored / KOL-only / creator-or-bot / tagged wallets, the weight that counts as 'weighted', when a wallet counts as exited, and the wallet count, holding USD and buy/sell ratio for strong, medium and single-pro signals.
